text:
maria: Kickoff: scheduling a pen-test retest window next week. Need RBAC freeze, KMS read-only evidence export, and signed handoff. Who owns ops on this?
sam: I can own ops for the week. Need exact list of roles to lock and timeframe.
maria: Thanks. Proposed window: Tue 2025-02-04 14:00-18:00 UTC. Freeze roles 30m before. Roles: staging-read, prod-readonly, pt-assessor (ephemeral).
joel: We can't give prod-readonly to external without ephemeral role + session factory. We have a flow: create temp IAM role with STS + log export ACL. I'll draft the policy.
maria: Perfect. @pen-test-bot, create ticket for ephemeral role and evidence bucket with retention 90d.
pen-test-bot: Ticket created: PT-2765. Created S3 bucket redwood-pt-evidence-2765, retention=90d, encrypted with KMS key: alias/pt-evidence. See https://redwood.internal/ticket/PT-2765
tayla: Quick Q: will the evidence export require KMS key wrapping? KMS policy changes need 48h lead.
maria: Yes, will need a key policy update to allow the assessor principal. Joel can you propose minimal key policy? Target: only decrypt for PutObject/GetObject when session principal has 'pt-assessor' tag.
joel: I'll post a diff. Also need to ensure CloudTrail logs for GetObject are retained. Suggest the following preflight checklist:

```bash
# preflight
aws iam create-role --role-name pt-assessor-temp ...
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/pt-evidence --policy file://pt-key-policy.json
# verify
aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-pt-evidence-2765 --key test.txt --body /dev/null
```
sam: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate the freeze window and add Ops rotation to oncall for Tue slot.
alice: From product/legal: need NDA signed before assessor access. Who will collect signatures?
maria: Security will verify. Sam, can you attach signed NDA to PT-2765 ticket before 14:00 UTC?
sam: On it. Also, for retest cadence: propose two 2-hour retest slots in following week, with automated regression checklist (vuln tags + repro steps).
tayla: For the regression checklist, we should include 'evidence hash' and 'log export ID' fields. Also include sample queries for telemetry: `error_rate > 0.1%` and `auth.failures > 5`.
maria: Good. We'll use the existing vuln tracker. Format for evidence entry:

- vuln-id
- repro steps
- evidence-bucket:path
- kms-key-alias
- timestamp
- assigned

joel: Posting key-policy draft: `pt-key-policy.json` -> allows kms:Decrypt kms:Encrypt for principal `arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/pt-assessor-temp/*` only if `pt-session=true` tag. Pasting snippet in ticket.
pen-test-bot: Reminder: Deployment freeze notice posted to #eng-releases and #eng-sre 48h before window.
tayla: Ops: Please run a dry-run Friday with sample assessor creds. `assume-role` flow should produce CloudTrail events tagged `pt-assessor`.
sam: Dry-run scheduled Fri 2025-01-31 16:00 UTC. I'll post results to PT-2765.
maria: Checklist for retest handoff: 1) NDA on ticket, 2) key policy applied, 3) evidence bucket accessible, 4) CloudTrail verified, 5) RBAC freeze note. If all green, proceed.
joel: One more: ensure rotation of the KMS key ciphertext material not required — we will create a new CMK for each engagement to avoid mixing evidence.
maria: Agree. New CMK per engagement. Closing: will follow up with ticket updates. Thanks y'all.
